[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (36.9→38.6) + 중립 판단 + 약한 반등 시도 확인
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.3894→-0.3610) + 유지 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 미확인

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($60.90) vs SMA5/20/50 ($60.52/$63.36/$64.42): Above SMA5, below SMA20/50 indicating short-term weakness and below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($62.43)/SMA200 ($59.34): Mixed mid-to-long-term trend, above SMA200 confirming long-term support.
· 52-week position (64.9%) + current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.9→38.6) + neutral assessment + weak rebound attempt confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.3894→-0.3610) + holding steady assessment + no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $63.36) + band width at 17.71% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($60.43) + basis (5-day low, above Pivot S1 $56.92).
· Swing resistance ($61.70) + potential for short-term upside breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + interpretation of lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.67) + low confidence in movement.
· Current phase assessment (accumulation) + entry/wait conditions: consider buying on a move above the 5-day low with accompanying volume.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가와 20일 저가 간의 'Higher Low' 패턴 미형성, 5일 고가와 20일 고가 간의 'Lower High' 패턴 미형성으로 뚜렷한 추세 전환 신호 부재. 현재 가격대는 52주 범위 중간 수준에서 횡보 국면 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Absence of clear trend reversal signals due to failure to form a 'Higher Low' between 5-day and 20-day lows, and a 'Lower High' between 5-day and 20-day highs. Current price range remains sideways within the mid-point of the 52-week range.
